The '''Epsilon 5''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda shuttle]] used in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] to transport [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] and [[Bevel Lemelisk]]. This [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was part of a group of five Lambda shuttles [[Liberation of Gial Ackbar|attacked]] in the [[Eriadu system/Legends|Eriadu system]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] forces in order to capture Tarkin and Lemelisk. The rebels failed to capture the pair but succeeded in liberating [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].
